case: Declared result metadata for empty SQLite queries
change: Prepare the query before execution and use its result-column metadata, including source origin, even when no row is returned. Resolve unknown declared types using pragma_table_xinfo on the same connection.
contract: Direct STRICT ANY columns report declared ANY for ordinary, parameterized and transaction queries that return rows and zero rows.
An empty app query result retains its CSV header and ANY metadata; the CSV is exactly the header line.
Computed expressions do not inherit ANY from their input column.
Catalog lookup failure leaves the query usable with the original metadata.
independent_oracle: Native SQLite query results plus a separate STRICT ANY CSV round trip checked by typeof(value) and exact returned Value.

focused_driver_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --test integration direct_query_columns_recover_declared_strict_any_metadata -- --test-threads=1

sqlite_driver_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite

app_strict_any_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib sqlite_any_contract -- --test-threads=1

app_full_library_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --all-targets -- -D warnings

validation.format_and_diff_checks: cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check passed

remaining: Computed expressions without a reportable declared type and attached-schema origins remain untyped where source metadata cannot be resolved safely.
Other SQLite output formats, storage-class/affinity combinations and installed GTK behavior remain open.
This case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
